file_name: Merivale - The Sackville Hotel - Third-party questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if The Three Weeds Hotel and The Sackville Hotel are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with The Merivale Group, Amalgamated Hotels and/or The Sackville Hotel.
